name: fast-container-for-ant
description: Ultra-low-latency macOS sandbox container creator & 1,000-container benchmark (APFS CoW + XNU DFA bytecode + Darwin ulock)

scripts.build:native: clang -std=c11 -O3 -flto -mcpu=native -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-deprecated-declarations native/test_1000.c native/sbx.c -lsandbox -flto -o native/test_1000 && clang -std=c11 -O3 -flto -mcpu=native -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-deprecated-declarations native/main.c native/sbx.c native/bench.c -lsandbox -flto -o native/sbx
scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:ts
